snippet.title: Beyond Solar – Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Beyond Solar is a fast, intense, story-driven shooter that blends retro atmosphere with modern action. You step into the cockpit as Gravity, a lone pilot tracing the last signals of a shattered resistance. Every region you cross reveals echoes of what happened, every fragment you collect brings you closer to the truth, and every fight pulls you deeper into the conflict your father once faced.

Early Access introduces the main journey, ranked 1v1 dogfights, and the core systems that define the game’s identity: tight controls, challenging encounters, and a world shaped by courage and consequence. The experience grows with each update as new chapters, enemies, and story sequences are added.

Beyond Solar is being built with care by COREGAME Studios, shaped by the communities that supported its development, and crafted for players who grew up loving the unmistakable feel of classic shooters.

Early Access begins soon. Step into the cockpit and start the fight.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281560/Beyond_Solar/
